record.question: How many types of acid treatments are there?
record.explanation: The printed Technical Paper-III (October 2020, page 7) asks how many types of acid treatment exist. Sericulture practice recognises two, hot acid and cold acid treatment, so the answer is 'Two'.

record.question: What is the ___________ specific gravity used in cold acid treatment when the temperature is 25oC?

Confidence is medium because it rests on recall rather than a source table.
